question: A gym records its classes in minutes and puts them on the timetable in hours. The gym had 120 towels in its cupboard, and 27 of them went to the laundry. A delivery brought 31 clean towels, and the laundry returned 51 more. Members then took 113 towels during the day. The gym has 18 running machines. How many towels are in the cupboard now?

Priya's plant nursery had 218 trays of seedlings, and 11 trays were spoiled by frost. A grower then delivered 66 more trays. Each tray holds 5 seedlings. A garden club later donated 72 loose seedlings to the nursery. Priya has more seedlings than her neighbour Anil has at his nursery. How many seedlings does Priya have?

A library counts its loan periods in days but writes them on the receipts in weeks. On Monday morning the returns trolley held 76 books, and 36 were shelved before lunch. In the early afternoon 73 books were returned, and later that afternoon 73 more came back. In the evening a helper shelved 76 books from the trolley. Just before closing a school returned 51 books to the same trolley. How many books are on the trolley?

A postal depot had 109 sacks of letters, and each sack holds 8 bundles. Every bundle holds 9 letters. On Tuesday 7298 letters were delivered to homes, and 21 letters were returned to sender and destroyed. A late collection added 41 letters to the depot, and a post box gave 29 more. How many letters are at the depot?

A swimming pool records its sessions in minutes and posts the timetable in hours. The pool had 102 kickboards in its store, and 47 were taken to the teaching pool. A school then borrowed 10 more. Each kickboard still in the store is stacked with 4 floats, and every float is cut from 2 foam blocks. How many foam blocks are in the store's floats?

A bus depot records its journeys in minutes but prints the timetable in hours. The depot had 192 ticket rolls, and each roll holds 6 books of tickets. Drivers used 1069 books during the month. A printer then delivered 80 books, and a spare cupboard gave up 45 more, but a rival depot borrowed 166. Hilda issued more books than her colleague Otto did, and a dozen buses are washed each night. How many books of tickets does the depot have?

A recycling centre had 166 sacks of cans, and a collection added 44 sacks and then 22 more. Each sack holds 9 boxes of cans. A school then donated 49 boxes. Every box holds 8 cans. Ferdi collected more sacks than his colleague Lotte did, and the centre opens at 7 each morning. How many cans does the centre have?

A campsite had 60 bundles of firewood, and a forester delivered 22 more. Each bundle holds 7 logs. A camper then brought 3 logs from home, and the warden found 9 logs behind the shed. The campsite has 45 pitches. How many logs are on the campsite?

A theatre counts its interval sales in cents and banks them in dollars. On Monday morning the store held 99 tubs of ice cream, and a delivery added 51 more. In the afternoon the tubs were shared equally among the theatre's 3 kiosks, and the foyer kiosk took its share. In the evening a supplier brought 78 more tubs to the foyer kiosk, and 127 tubs were sold during the show. Each tub still at that kiosk fills 3 cones. The theatre seats 600 people. How many cones can the foyer kiosk fill?

Bea had 19 boxes of tiles in her hallway, and a delivery brought 34 more. A friend gave her 8 boxes, and a clearance sale added 67 more. Each box holds 3 packs, and every pack holds 2 tiles. Bea now has more boxes than her brother Milo has in his garage. How many tiles does Bea have?

A youth club records its hall time in minutes and posts it on the door in hours. The club had 24 footballs in its store cupboard. A donation added 31 balls. A school then borrowed 20 balls, and 27 balls were found flat and thrown out. A coach later brought 8 new balls. How many footballs are in the cupboard?

Nils had 113 sheets of stamps in his collection, and an auction added 75 sheets. He then sold 42 sheets to a dealer. Each sheet holds 9 blocks, and every block holds 7 stamps. Nils owns more stamps than his sister Frida does. How many stamps does Nils own?

A bakery had 214 sacks of flour, and each sack fills 5 tubs of dough. A second mixer then doubled the number of tubs the bakery had. Every tub is divided into 3 trays. The trays were shared equally among the bakery's 6 ovens, and Nora took the oven by the door. She baked 934 trays during the day, while her colleague Piet baked fewer at his own oven. How many trays are still waiting at Nora's oven?

On Monday morning a farm shop had 80 boxes of eggs, and a farmer brought 21 more before lunch. In the afternoon the boxes were opened, and each box holds 6 eggs. In the early evening a neighbour gave the shop 5 loose eggs, and just before closing a second neighbour brought 21 more. How many eggs are in the farm shop?

On Monday morning a florist had 71 stems of lilies. Before lunch 44 stems were used in bouquets, and in the early afternoon 3 stems wilted and were thrown away. Later that afternoon the florist cut every remaining stem into 3 short sprigs for table decorations. In the evening 1 sprig was dropped on the floor and 3 more were given to a customer. The shop closes at 6. How many sprigs does the florist have?

A hotel had 88 rolls of wallpaper in its store, and a decorator brought 6 more. 7 rolls were damaged by damp and thrown out. Each roll covers 5 panels of wall, and every panel needs 3 strips of paper. The decorator then found 8 spare strips in his van. A dozen ladders are kept in the yard. How many strips of paper does the hotel have?

A hardware shop had 53 boxes of screws on each of its 8 racks. A delivery then added 45 loose boxes. Each box holds 3 packets, and every packet holds 3 screws. The shop has 2 checkouts. How many screws are in the shop?

On Monday morning a fruit packer filled 196 trays on each of its 7 lines. Before lunch a farm delivered 74 more trays, and in the afternoon a second farm sent 37. In the evening 1111 trays were loaded onto lorries for the supermarkets. The packing shed has 9 doors. How many trays are still in the shed?

A village hall had 209 chairs in its store. A school lent the hall 26 chairs, and a church added 62 more. A wedding party then took 88 chairs away to a marquee. A furniture firm later delivered 55 new chairs to the store. A dozen tables are stacked against the wall. How many chairs are in the store now?

On Monday morning Tara had 15 packets of bulbs in her shed, which is 3 metres wide, and she gave 8 packets to the school garden. In the afternoon she opened the packets that were left, and each packet holds 7 bulbs. That evening a neighbour gave her 26 more bulbs, and the next day a market stall sold her 16 more. She then found that 14 bulbs had rotted and threw them out. Every bulb she planted grew 6 flowers, and Tara ended the summer with more flowers than her friend Meera had. How many flowers did Tara grow?

A dairy records its milk in litres although the churns are still marked in gallons. On Monday morning the dairy had 201 churns standing in the yard. Before lunch 143 churns went out on the rounds, and in the early afternoon 6 churns came back and were refilled. In the evening 24 churns were sent to a cheese maker. Each churn still in the yard holds 7 litres of milk, and a dozen cats live in the barn beside it. How many litres of milk are in the yard?

A cafe counts its baking time in minutes and writes it on the board in hours. The cafe had 13 tubs of icing in the fridge. 6 tubs were used for a wedding cake, 2 for cupcakes and 2 more for biscuits. Each tub still in the fridge fills 5 piping bags. The pastry chef then made more icing and tripled the number of piping bags. During the week 35 bags were used up. How many piping bags does the cafe have?

A stadium sells its drinks in millilitres although the cups are printed in litres. The store had 150 pallets of cups, and each pallet holds 4 boxes. Every box holds 7 sleeves of cups. A late delivery added 33 sleeves to the store. Each sleeve holds 5 cups. How many cups are in the store?

On Monday morning a garden centre had 149 sacks of bulbs, and a grower delivered 77 more before lunch. In the afternoon a second grower brought 58 sacks. In the evening every sack was opened, and each one holds 7 bulbs. On Tuesday 439 bulbs were sold and a customer returned 26. Ines sold more bulbs that week than her colleague Piet did, and a dozen robins follow the gardeners around. How many bulbs does the centre have?

A print shop had 40 boxes of leaflets, and a client delivered 76 more. The manager then ran the presses again and tripled the number of boxes in the shop. Each box holds 9 bundles of leaflets. A campaign used 1599 bundles. The bundles that were left were shared equally among the shop's 3 vans. How many bundles are in one van?
